mentions.name: Ato: Discover & Compete
mentions.description: This iOS app is a co-op world tracker for city exploration: it turns Apple Workouts and Photos location data into hex-based map coverage of the places you've been, and combines your coverage with friends' data on the author's servers for shared global stats. It expands an earlier street-tracking app with city- and country-wide coverage.
mentions.problem: Street-level coverage tracking became impractical to maintain after moving cities, and users of the old app emailed asking for city/country-wide stats.
mentions.source_excerpt: it prompted the idea to have a co-op world tracker, with sides of city exploration. Built this iOS app - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ato-discover-compete/id6757285141. Works with Apple Workouts + Photos location data.
